svg.text: The agent graph: what happens on every caller turn
services/agent/app/graph.py wires 11 nodes together. Diamonds are the routing functions in routing.py.
Picks the intent and how sure it is
Asks for the PIN on the keypad.
Pulls out account and amount, then
caller types it on the keypad
Fills in a fixed reply template. Every green pill lands here.
Masked summary for a person. Every red pill lands here.
PAUSES: the graph stops (LangGraph interrupt) and saves its state (checkpointer). The gateway collects the PIN, code or yes itself,
then resumes the graph with only the result. On the next turn the caller starts again at the top, but the saved state remembers they're verified.
execute re-checks the same gates as the diamonds on purpose: verified, a clear yes for changes, and the code for big transfers.
